sloka: तस्य वै नर सिंहस्य सिंह उरस्कस्य भामिनी ।प्राणेभ्यो अपि प्रियतरा भार्या नित्यम् अनुव्रता ॥३-३७-१९॥
transliteration: tasya vai nara siṁhasya siṁha uraskasya bhāminī ।prāṇebhyo api priyatarā bhāryā nityam anuvratā ॥3-37-19॥

translations.english: Beautiful Sita happens to be the wife of Rama who is like a lion among men. Rama has a broad chest like that of a lion. He loves Sita who is ever loyal to him, more than his life.
